reason: I already track applications in a spreadsheet, and setting up a database plus provider keys sounds like more work than switching to this would save me. The fact that I still have to pay for hosting or APIs also makes the 'free' part less clear.
objection: I don't want to spend an evening troubleshooting a self-hosted setup just to get the same tracking I already have in my spreadsheet.
would_change_my_mind: A simple install I can finish in a few minutes, with a demo search and a clear estimate of any provider costs.
